content: sharp has no native text-drawing API; the standard workaround is to build an SVG <text> element and sharp.composite() it onto the base image. For Hebrew/RTL, adding direction='rtl' to the <svg> element sets correct base direction (sharp rasterizes SVG via libvips/librsvg, which uses Pango for text shaping, so bidi and Hebrew glyph shaping are handled correctly). Caveat: SVG text compositing in sharp is measurably slower (seconds, not ms) than simple image composites.
